results.title: Dream Industrial REIT Announces August 2026 Monthly Distribution
results.description: TORONTO--(BUSINESS WIRE)--DREAM INDUSTRIAL REIT (TSX: DIR.UN) (the “Trust”) announced today its August 2026 monthly distribution in the amount of $0.05979 per Unit ($0.7175 annualized). The August distribution will be payable on September 15, 2026 to unitholders of record as at August 31, 2026. Dream Industrial REIT is an owner, manager, and operator of a global portfolio of well-located, diversified industrial properties.
